headline_zh: 16/16 (100.0%) 确定性拦截 x402 签名前制裁/超支、Stripe DXT 无警示工具与 MCP Inspector 暴露
headline_en: 16/16 (100.0%) Deterministic Guard Across x402 Pre-Sign Pay Guard, Stripe DXT & MCP Inspector

scenarios.title_zh: x402 签名前三层 Pay Guard、异步 Bazaar、Fastify 原始文本与 Cardano CIP-30 合规基线
scenarios.title_en: Compliant x402 Pre-Sign Pay Guard, Async Bazaar, Fastify Raw Body & Cardano CIP-30
scenarios.reason: All x402 pre-sign pay guards, async Bazaar, Fastify raw body, v2 amount, and Cardano CIP-30 checks passed.

scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3851/#3845 OFAC 制裁或钓鱼/盗币地址签名前阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 #3851/#3845 Pre-Sign OFAC SDN & Drainer/Phishing Address Block
scenarios.reason: Pre-sign pay guard blocked signing due to OFAC/drainer/phishing verdict or fail-closed screen (#3851/#3845).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3816 Tanilo 合同价格矛盾或超出支出上限阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 #3816 Tanilo Contract Price Mismatch or Spend Cap Breach Block
scenarios.reason: Tanilo pre-sign guard rejected contradicted contract price, spend cap, or indeterminate receipt (#3816).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3815 UTA Trust Kit 未验签 ATC/1.0 信任卡或无偿付能力阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 #3815 UTA Trust Kit Unverified ATC/1.0 Card or Insolvent Agent Block
scenarios.reason: UTA Trust Kit rejected caller without Ed25519-verified ATC/1.0 card and solvency proof (#3815).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3842 Python Bazaar 误调同步 `_get_client()` 或空查询阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 #3842 Python Bazaar Sync `_get_client()` AttributeError or Empty Query Block
scenarios.reason: Bazaar discovery requires async _get_async_client() and non-empty search query before HTTP (#3842).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3834 Fastify `text/plain` 结算失败响应被二次 JSON 序列化阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 #3834 Fastify `text/plain` Settlement Failure Double JSON-Encoding Block
scenarios.reason: Fastify onSend must send non-JSON string settlement-failure bodies as-is without JSON quoting (#3834).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3828 客户端对非整数原子单位金额擅自四舍五入/缩放阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 #3828 Client-Side Rounding/Rescaling of Invalid Atomic Amount Block
scenarios.reason: x402 v2 clients must validate scheme-specific amount representations rather than round or rescale (#3828).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3825 Go 包装 `*x402.SettleError` 丢失交易哈希或退化为 500 阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 #3825 Go Wrapped `*x402.SettleError` HTTP 500 or Lost Tx Hash Block
scenarios.reason: Wrapped *x402.SettleError must map to HTTP 200 SettleResponse preserving transaction hash (#3825).

scenarios.title_zh: x402 #3790 Cardano CIP-30 Paywall 使用不受支持的 `script`/`masumi` 方式阻断
scenarios.title_en: x402 #3790 Cardano CIP-30 Paywall Unsupported `script`/`masumi` Method Block
scenarios.reason: Cardano CIP-30 paywall only supports exact default transfer in ADA/USDM with min-UTxO & tab lock (#3790).

scenarios.reason: Stripe DXT manifest safety notes, SHA-pinned workflows, Metronome hooks, and pytest discovery verified.
